newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY WELFARE MINISTER OFFERED RESIGNATION - TV.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY WELFARE MINISTER OFFERED RESIGNATION - TV.

text.p: Hungarian welfare minister Gyorgy Szabo has offered his resignation to Prime Minister Gyula Horn, Hungarian television reported in its evening news programme on Wednesday.
Horn informed the Socialist Party's afternoon presidium meeting about the resignation, but said he did not accept it yet.
Szabo's has offered his resignation for personal reasons, the report said.
